inputs.text: [excited][playful] And now we're at [serious] paleontology! [happily] How do we know all this? [curious] Thanks to scientists who dig in the ground.
[curious][playful] Paleontologists. [excited] They find bones, teeth, footprints, eggs. [softly] They clean them with a toothbrush, very, very gently.
[excited][quickly] They fit hundreds of bones back together, like a giant puzzle! [happily] They figure out how the animal walked and what it ate.
[playful][chuckles] Almost! [softly] But not the colors. [serious] Nobody knows. [happily] So artists imagine them.
[excited][playful] Maybe! [gasps] Or covered in feathers: a giant meat-eating chicken! [happily] Was Triceratops blue? Pink? [playful] Yellow with spots? [shouts] You get to imagine it!
[chuckles][happily] Orange. Perfect. [softly] We don't know everything. [happily] But we know life is one huge adventure, [pauses] from the very first bacterium to the birds of today.
[happily][excited] Anytime you want. [playful] The journey is right here, [pauses] always ready.
